title: 第19章 拿下到手离去第20章 提前准备炼气六层
content_zh:
百宝阁外，炼气六层中期圆满的贺初云为首，身后还跟着一位面无表情的中年男子，名为谭子明，炼气六层初期。
紧接着便是炼气五层张庆民，以及顾景元了。
四人出发，直奔山脉。
在顾景元的带领下，一个时辰后，一行人来到洞口外。
顾景元开口：“就是这里面，我亲眼所见。”
这时候贺初云看向张庆民，张庆民点了点头。
他之所以来，一是为了让贺初云的父亲帮忙举荐他成为管事，二来便是他养了一只下品寻药鼠。
可寻找一些灵药，当然也能找人。
一只巴掌大小的青毛鼠被拿出，闻了闻后，连忙点头。
张庆民抬头道：“确实有人的气息，但不是很浓郁了。”
贺初云点头，继续道：“让这寻药鼠在前面开道，它体型小，即便有埋伏也不一定攻击到它，一旦不对它可以提前给我们预警。”
“好。”
张庆民没有拒绝。
很快，一行人进入洞中。
在寻药鼠的带领下，弯弯绕绕的走到一处石门之前。
贺初云：“果然有人。”
说着，贺初云就准备出手，要一举将石门击碎，直接杀了进去。
“等等，寻药鼠说这门旁边并没有人的气息。”
说着，张庆民发现寻药鼠慢慢的朝着侧边走去，几人跟着。
但几人靠近的刹那，贺初云和顾景元几乎同时看向那边，刚刚那石壁有一处很轻的动静，似乎是脚步声。

“就是就是这里，碎岩术！”
随着砰的一声，石壁被击碎，一个洞口出现，同时一个阵盘掉落。
张庆民看着阵盘，道：“下品拟境盘，模仿周围环境。”
顾景元提醒道：“等下，这洞口一眼看去狭长，若是对方在另一端出手，那可太危险了。”
贺初云问道：“那你有什么好办法？”
顾景元：“我建议，谭道友在这边堵住，以焚烧草木，若是身上有毒物，也可加入，以浓烟灌入逼迫对方出来。我们三人则是出去在周围观察，对方选择这边作为据点，易守难攻，肯定还有逃生通道。”
“有道理，到时候传音符箓联系。”
贺初云点头看向谭子明，后者点头。
然后三人往外走，紧接着三人成犄角之势，立于大树之上，观察四周。
很快，洞中浓烟滚滚，还夹杂毒雾，外面的三人死死盯着那些冒出烟雾的地方。
此刻，洞中。
“不好，这些人居然以毒烟逼迫，不能等了，我们撤离。”
content_en:
Outside the Baibao Pavilion, He Chuyun, who was in the middle stage of the sixth level of Qi refining, was headed, followed by an expressionless middle-aged man named Tan Ziming, who was in the early stage of the sixth level of Qi refining.
Next came Zhang Qingmin and Gu Jingyuan, who were on the fifth level of Qi Refining.
The four of them set off and headed straight for the mountains.
Under the leadership of Gu Jingyuan, the group arrived outside the cave entrance an hour later.
Gu Jingyuan said, "It's right here, I saw it with my own eyes."
At this time, He Chuyun looked at Zhang Qingmin, and Zhang Qingmin nodded.
The reason why he came was firstly to ask He Chuyun's father to help recommend him to become the steward, and secondly because he had raised a low-grade poison-seeking rat.
You can look for some elixirs, and of course you can also find people.
A palm-sized green-haired rat was taken out, and after sniffing it, he nodded quickly.
Zhang Qingmin raised his head and said, "It does smell like someone, but it's not very strong."
He Chuyun nodded and continued: "Let this drug-seeking rat clear the way in front. It is small in size. Even if there is an ambush, it may not be able to attack it. If something goes wrong, it can give us an early warning."
"Okay."
Zhang Qingmin did not refuse.
Soon, a group of people entered the cave.
Under the leadership of the drug-seeking rat, they walked in a winding way to a stone gate.
He Chuyun: "There is indeed someone."
With that said, He Chuyun was ready to take action, to smash the stone door into pieces in one fell swoop and kill directly in.
"Wait a minute, the Poison Rat said there's no human scent next to this door."
As he spoke, Zhang Qingmin noticed that the drug-seeking rat slowly walked to the side, followed by several people.
But the moment they approached, He Chuyun and Gu Jingyuan looked over there almost at the same time. There was a very light movement on the stone wall just now, which seemed to be the sound of footsteps.
"It's right here, the rock breaking technique!"
With a bang, the stone wall was shattered, a hole appeared, and at the same time a formation disk fell.
Zhang Qingmin looked at the formation disk and said: "The low-grade imitation disk imitates the surrounding environment."
Gu Jingyuan reminded: "Wait a minute, this hole looks long and narrow at first glance. If the other party attacks from the other end, it will be too dangerous."
He Chuyun asked: "Then what good idea do you have?"
Gu Jingyuan: "I suggest that Fellow Daoist Tan block here to burn the vegetation. If there are poisons on his body, he can also join in and force the opponent to come out by pouring thick smoke. The three of us went out to observe the surroundings. The opponent chose this side as a stronghold. It is easy to defend but difficult to attack. There must be an escape route."
"That makes sense. We'll contact you via telegraph when the time comes."
He Chuyun nodded and looked at Tan Ziming, who nodded.
Then the three of them walked out, and then the three of them stood on the big tree and observed their surroundings.
Soon, thick smoke was billowing in the cave, mixed with poisonous mist. The three people outside stared at the places where the smoke was coming out.
At this moment, in the cave.
"No, these people are forcing us with poisonous smoke. We can't wait any longer. Let's evacuate."
